_note: Answer key written when the BRD was constructed: where each atom's knowledge really came from. Used ONLY for scoring. Categories: REG = the regulation excerpt given to the system; REG_GUIDANCE = supervisory guidance not in the corpus (RBI/FIU-IND); REG_FORMAT = regulator technical specification; INT_POLICY / INT_SYSTEM / INT_DECISION / INT_PROCESS = the bank's own policies, systems/data, recorded decisions and interpretations, and procedures. gold_sources lists acceptable catalog entries (source_catalog.json).
